additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370927-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002106] Spare part does not comply with values of specification CRM:00642001342
additional_info.body:
Hello Mohini,
30mA is the maximum amperage leak. RCD should react below that value, meaning 22,5mA is a sufficient value. We measure with ramp-up.
However, if there is an applied difference of 30mA on the RCD with our measuring device (Metrel MI 3122), the RCD reacts above 300ms.
We did the same type of measurements on other chargers and received satisfactory values. This one is the only one causing problems.
Kind regards,
Milan

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370927-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002106] Spare part does not comply with values of specification CRM:00642001342
additional_info.body:
Hello Milan,
Hope you are doing great.
Generally, RCD tests are conducted as follows:
RCD is injected with half of the rated current. In this scenario, it should not trip. (this is done to check any nuisance tripping).
RCD is injected with the rated current (in this case 30mA) here it should trip at maximum within 300ms.
RCD is injected with 5times the rated current. here it should trip within maximum within 40ms.
When we perform the rated test, its not necessary that the RCD trips at 30mA. It can trip below 30mA, for example 21, or 22 or 23mA. This is checked generally using a ramp test.
BUT
when the ramp test is performed, generally they do not check the time taken to trip.
IF
the time taken to trip for 30mA is below 300ms then the RCD should be fine.
Please provide details for the following questions, it would be greatly appreciated and will enable us to offer further assistance.
Have they done the test on half, rated and 5xrated current? Is the time value below 300ms for 30mA rated?
For ramp up, generally time is not calculated. Is there any standard which they are referring to for checking ramp up test trip time?
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
